name: rbac-roles
description: RBAC engine ported from superspace: 6 system role presets (owner/admin/manager/staff/client/guest), dot-namespaced permissions with `*` / `feature.*` matching, pure check helpers, and props-driven UI primitives (PermissionGate, usePermissions, RoleBadge, PermissionMatrix). Convex template ships a tenant-scoped rbac_roles table + checkPermission / requirePermission + seedSystemRoles.
notes: 0.2.0 (2026-05-31): real engine landed (was a config-only stub). Split design — this is the engine; the members/invites/roles-admin UI lives in the user-management slice (peers this). Ported from superspace convex/workspace/{permissions,roles.config} + convex/lib/rbac. Generic tenantId (not workspace-locked). Pure + props-driven.
